title: File:Trecho do Caminho do Ouro em Parati-RJ (1519027780).jpg
claims: The photograph shows a section of the Caminho do Ouro near Paraty as a broad old stone road: irregular, moss-covered blocks run through dense Atlantic Forest, with fallen leaves and branches across the stones and no people or race furniture in the frame.

Commons titles the file Trecho do Caminho do Ouro em Parati-RJ (1519027780).jpg and describes it as a section of the Caminho do Ouro in Parati, Rio de Janeiro; the categories include Atlantic Forest and Nature of Paraty. It shows the old road environment, not a confirmed 2027 race segment, start/finish arch, aid station, course marking, timing mat or race-day crowd.

The author is Glauco Umbelino; the file is licensed CC BY 2.0; the photograph was taken on 2007-07-26 at 13:06; the original is 2,048 x 1,536 pixels and 1,597,101 bytes, and the file page gives no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 410,432 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Glauco Umbelino, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
